feeling: Quiet grief in a small place, then a hard turn into a fight you can win.
intent: A video that starts somber and slow, then cuts to action: a story told in two halves.
listen_for: The snare roll, the beat where the lead stops just before 0:18, and the fight crashing in after it.

parts.name: embers
parts.change: long single notes over held chords, a kick every other bar
parts.feels: still and alone: a village at dusk

parts.name: doubt
parts.change: the chords fall to f; the lead is still slow

parts.name: build
parts.change: the bass rises in eighths, a snare roll, then one beat of silence

parts.name: fight
parts.change: everything arrives: eighth-note lead and bass, a full drum

parts.name: last-stand
parts.change: the lead climbs higher; the drum fills the last bar of each four
parts.feels: all or nothing: the last push

parts.name: end
parts.change: one held chord and a kick
